title: Consensys - Building the Era of Decentralized Finance
metaDescription: Consensys is a blockchain software company building the tools, infrastructure and research that power the new Era of Decentralized Finance, for a more secure and open economy

headings.text: Building the era of Decentralized Finance
The internet revolutionized the movement of information, it's time to do the same for capital.
Our vertically integrated platform converts user and application intent into successful onchain outcomes, from authorization and routing to execution and settlement.
The Protocol Powering the Future of Finance

From Block 0 through The Merge and beyond, Consensys has been instrumental in Ethereum's evolution into the world's most vital public blockchain — the core trust infrastructure for the global economy.
The Pectra upgrade to the execution and consensus layers introduced Smart Accounts and other powerful features
The Dencun Upgrade introduced proto-danksharding and blobs, making L2s vastly more efficient
Changing to proof-of-stake, the Merge reduced Ethereum's energy use by 99.95% ensuring sustainable, scalable support for the onchain future

Founded in 2014 by Ethereum co-founder Joseph Lubin, Consensys has been a core contributor to the Ethereum ecosystem since before the genesis block — with a vision to build technology that makes finance more open, accessible, and equitable for everyone.

(opens in new tab) INFRASTRUCTURE FOR A NEW GLOBAL ECONOMY The internet revolutionized the movement of information, it's time to do the same for capital. Get the Trustware report Our financial system is overdue for its broadband moment — and we're building the platform and infrastructure to enable it. Ethereum makes trust programmable: cryptographic, consensus-driven, and verifiable.We call the technology built on this foundation trustware. From MetaMask — the consumer finance platform trusted by millions — to Infura's developer infrastructure and the protocol clients securing the network, Consensys is building the complete trustware finance stack. The Trustware Finance Stack See all products Our vertically integrated platform converts user and application intent into successful onchain outcomes, from authorization and routing to execution and settlement. MetaMask MetaMask is the world's most widely adopted self-custodial finance platform, with over millions of users and billions of dollars in digital assets secured. Users send, trade, earn, pay, and connect — all through a single interface backed by integrated transaction security, optimized routing, and cross-chain infrastructure. Download MetaMask (opens in new tab) Users MConnected Dapps k MetaMask Developer MetaMask Developer enables third-party application builders and agents to integrate with MetaMask and distribute digital asset experiences to millions of users — from wallet connections via the Connect SDK to embedded wallet functionality, all within MetaMask's non-custodial security model. Explore Developer Products (opens in new tab) Users MDapps k+ Infura Infura is the Internet Service Provider for Ethereum and other blockchain networks — scalable API infrastructure so developers can read and write to supported chains without operating their own nodes. Infura powers thousands of decentralized applications with high-availability endpoints, developer tools, and enterprise-grade performance.
